entry.title: SPS: 随机路径采样器 / Stochastic Path Sampler

link.title: SPS: 随机路径采样器 / Stochastic Path Sampler

entry.content:
从只有作用量、没有训练样本的采样问题出发，介绍 SPS 的正反路径、训练目标、路径权重和 Metropolis 修正。正文包含论文原图和两个交互演示。

阅读全文与交互图

Starting from an action and no training samples, this post introduces SPS through its forward and backward paths, training objective, path weights, and Metropolis correction. It includes figures from the paper and two interactive demos.

Read the full post and interactive figures

S. Chen, M. Qian, G. Aarts, B. Lucini, and K. Zhou, Stochastic Path Sampler For Lattice Field Theory, arXiv:2606.13790.
entry.summary: 从路径熵产生到 Metropolis 修正。From path entropy production to Metropolis correction.
